# Hello World Skill

This skill greets the user with a friendly message.

## Usage

Ask the agent to say hello, and it will respond with a warm greeting.

## Examples

- "Say hello" → "Hello! How can I help you today?"
- "Greet me" → "Hi there! What would you like to do?"
